### 4. Computations
**Feed re-review (`96af3374`).** Tests doc: lienholder → deductibles vs plan ceiling → coverage-reach. Plan B ceiling 500.00 (requirement terms table). Raises: collision — book value 11900.00 ≤ 12500 → +500 (feed book-value doc); credit tier "Tier 5 Rebuild" → +250 (feed credit-tier doc) → collision ceiling 1250; comprehensive — LTV 13600/11900 = 114.3 % → +250 (feed LTV doc); model year 2019 → +250 (feed model-year doc) → comp ceiling 1000. Shown 1000/1250 ≤ ceilings (both exactly on the boundary, so the raises must be applied cumulatively — each doc says the ceiling "is raised by"). Reach date: contract paid off → date of first review 2026-08-04 (feed reach-date doc); buffer: TX → 7 days (feed state buffer doc). 08-18 is 14 days after 08-04 ≥ 7 → pass. Outcome `accepted`. Fall-back (tests doc only: ceiling 500, reach = today 10-19, buffer 15) → `rejected_deductible_too_high`.
**Upload re-review (`cff25178`).** Binder period 07-06..07-11 = 6 days ≤ 30 → is a binder. Collision ceiling 500+500 (book value)+250 (tier) = 1250 ≥ 1250; comp ceiling 500+250 (model year 2019) = 750 ≥ 750 (no LTV allowance exists for uploads). Reach test: exp 07-11 on/after reach date = first review 07-08 (paid off) → pass. Outcome `accepted`. Fall-back → `rejected_deductible_too_high`.
**Closing-month refund.** Charge premium 79.85; period days 07-06..08-05 = 31. Proofs read (one accepted per channel after the re-reviews): agent call Bluebonnet (does not count), upload Pecos (counts, reaches; span 07-06..07-11), feed Gulf Coast (counts, reaches; span 07-18..08-05). No counting proof took effect on/before 03-07 → not full; reaching proofs exist → `pro_rata_from_proof_effective`.
- Fall-back (computation doc alone): covered days = latest effective date among reaching proofs (07-18) through closed date 08-05 = 19; post-closing 0 → 79.85 × 19 / 31 = 48.9403 → **48.94**.
- Factor: covered days with two reaching proofs = union of spans = 6 + 19 = 25 (covered-days/overlapping-proofs doc).
- Factor: replacement days = 07-12..07-17 = 6; graces: state TX 2 (state grace doc), model year 2019 → 1 (model-year grace doc), book value 11900 ≤ 12500 → 2 (vehicle-value grace doc) = 5 ≤ 6.
- Refundable = 25 + 5 + 0 = 30 → 79.85 × 30 / 31 = 77.2742 → **77.27**, basis `pro_rata_from_proof_effective`; ≥ 1.00 so mailed.
- Record words that led to each factor: contract record `state_code TX`, `vehicle_year 2019`, `vehicle_book_value_usd 11900.0`, `variant_name Tier 5 Rebuild`, `amount_financed_usd 13600.0`, `status paid_off`; tracking activity rows with `verification_source` insurer_edi_feed / declarations_page_upload and their effective/expiration dates. Searches used business words ("insurer-feed re-review model year", "closing-month refund state", "covered days several proofs").

### 6. Problem tree (visible materials only)
Root: closing-month refund check (customer's own write).
- Hop A (root ← feed re-review): hub sentence "The closing-month refund is fixed only after the records carry an accepted re-review of every rejected insurer-feed proof whose shown coverage reaches into that billing period." Records: feed row `96af3374` rejected, coverage 07-18..08-18 reaches into 07-06..08-05 → state unmet. Searched "re-review insurer-feed proof" → feed desk reference describes a re-review that "adds one new proof-review entry ... carrying the outcome passed in" on a closed record → that write brings the state about when the tests give `accepted`. **state-derived**.
- Hop B (root ← upload re-review): "The closing-month refund is not fixed until the records carry an accepted re-review of every rejected uploaded binder whose shown coverage reaches into that billing period." Records: upload `cff25178` rejected, 07-06..07-11 within the period → unmet. Upload desk reference ("Re-Review of an Uploaded Insurance Binder on a Closed Tracking Record") records the re-review entry. **state-derived**.
- No further hops: re-review docs carry no prerequisite sentence. Order: A and B (any order) → root.

### Counter-proofs
- "Do only the refund": without the re-reviews no accepted proof counts for the period (Bluebonnet expired 2026-02-14), so the hub does not fix the charge and the base rule (restated in the hub) gives `pro_rata_from_closure` with 0 post-closing days → 0.00, below the 1.00 check floor; and the prerequisite sentences forbid fixing the closing-month refund while the rejected feed/upload rows stand. Excluded by the blocked side's own sentences + records (no pre-solved statement).
- Closest alternatives excluded: `full_no_lapse` (no counting proof effective ≤ 03-07); closing-period rule (period ends on closed date); crediting the contract (paid off → check); non-cumulative raises (would reject the feed proof at comp 1000 > 750 — the docs give each allowance as an additive raise; see note); baseline buffer 15 (TX schedule gives 7).
- Note for step 2: whether allowances on the same deductible stack is entailed only by each doc's "is raised by" wording (no doc says how two raises combine); "For a contract of any other state this schedule sets no expiry buffer" is open between 0 and the product figure (not triggered here).
